limitations.statement: Catalog entry only; execution is disabled in this MVP.
No admitted capsule binds exact CPython, its standard library, and the pinned charterlock distribution.
The measurer needs separately bound charter, keyring, executor identities, execution time, and journey or claim inputs; EWB has no admitted input-set contract for them.
Read-only measurement and maturity checks must be separated from key generation and signing operations that write secret-bearing files.
CHARTER_SPLIT does not prove two people, two organizations, or absence of collusion; upstream independence_claim remains not_claimed.
